analytics.otoroshi.io.UserAlert.description: A user analytics alert: conditions on the analytics queries of the active user-analytics data exporter, evaluated periodically on a sliding window. When they hold, an alert event (`AlertEvent` with `alert` set to `UserAnalyticsAlert`) is sent to the data exporters, at most once per cooldown period

id.description: The id of the alert, used in the paths of `/api/analytics/alerts/{alertId}/events` and copied as `alertId` into the events it emits. A random one is generated when it is missing or empty

name.description: The name of the alert, shown in the backoffice and copied as `alertName` into the events it emits
name.example: High error rate on the billing api

description.description: A free text telling what the alert watches, shown under its name on the page of its fired events in the backoffice. Unlike `message`, it is not copied into the events
description.example: More than 5% of the calls fail

tags.description: Free tags of the alert, to search and sort it

metadata.description: Free key/value metadata of the alert

enabled.description: Whether the alert is evaluated: a disabled alert never fires. Defaults to true

windowSeconds.description: The duration of the sliding window the queries are run on, in seconds. Defaults to 300

evaluationIntervalSeconds.description: The delay between two evaluations of the alert, in seconds. Defaults to 60. The evaluation job runs every 60 seconds on a single instance of the cluster, so a shorter delay acts as 60 seconds

cooldownSeconds.description: The minimum delay between two events emitted by the alert, in seconds. Defaults to 600

severity.description: The severity of the alert, copied into the events it emits. Defaults to `warning`

message.description: The text of the events the alert emits (their `message`), for the people and the systems that receive them
message.example: The error rate of the billing api is above 5%

combine.description: How the conditions are combined: `AND` when all of them must hold, `OR` when one is enough. Defaults to `AND`, the value is case insensitive

conditions.description: The conditions of the alert. An alert without condition never fires. A condition that cannot be read is dropped

example.name: High error rate on the billing api
example.description: More than 5% of the calls fail
example.message: The error rate of the billing api is above 5%

AlertCondition.description: A condition of a user analytics alert: an analytics query run on the window of the alert, its result reduced to a single number, compared to a threshold

query.description: The id of an analytics query of the catalog (`GET /api/analytics/_schema` lists them), like `requests_total`, `error_rate_ts` or `duration_avg_ts`

params.description: The parameters of the query, as listed in the catalog of the queries (for instance `top_n`)

filters.description: The entities the query is restricted to, for this condition only. An empty or missing value does not filter

route_id.description: Only the calls handled by this route (its id)

api_id.description: Only the calls handled by this api (its id)

apikey_id.description: Only the calls made with this api key (its client id)

group_id.description: Only the calls of the routes of this service group (its id)

err.description: Only the calls that failed (`true`) or only the ones that succeeded (`false`)

reducer.description: How the result of the query (a timeseries, the first series of a multi-series timeseries, a top or a single value) is reduced to a single number. Defaults to `avg`, the value is case insensitive. A condition whose query returns no value does not hold

operator.description: How the reduced value is compared to the threshold. Defaults to `>`, another value never holds

threshold.description: The value the reduced result is compared to. Defaults to 0

analytics.otoroshi.io.UserDashboard.description: A user analytics dashboard: a grid of widgets, each one showing the result of an analytics query of the active user-analytics data exporter

id.description: The id of the dashboard. A random one is generated when it is missing or empty

name.description: The name of the dashboard, shown in the list of the dashboards and at the top of the dashboard in the backoffice

description.description: A free text telling what the dashboard shows, displayed in the list of the dashboards and under the name of the dashboard in the backoffice
description.example: Traffic, errors and latency of the billing api

tags.description: Free tags of the dashboard, to search and sort it

metadata.description: Free key/value metadata of the dashboard. The default dashboards created by otoroshi carry `otoroshi-default-id` and `otoroshi-default-version`

enabled.description: Whether the dashboard is enabled, an information for the backoffice: otoroshi itself does not read it. Defaults to true

widgets.description: The widgets of the dashboard, in display order. A widget that cannot be read is dropped

defaults.description: The filters the backoffice applies when the dashboard is opened without filters in its url, saved from the filters of the dashboard by its editor. Empty when there are none

from.description: The start of the time range: `now`, `now-<n><unit>` with a unit among `s`, `m`, `h` and `d`, or an ISO-8601 instant

to.description: The end of the time range: `now`, `now-<n><unit>` with a unit among `s`, `m`, `h` and `d`, or an ISO-8601 instant

route.description: Only the calls of this route (its id)

api.description: Only the calls of this api (its id)

apikey.description: Only the calls made with this api key (its client id)

group.description: Only the calls of the routes of this service group (its id)

refresh.description: The auto refresh period, in seconds, as a string. `0` disables it

compare.description: `1` (or `true`) to compare the results with the previous period of the same length, anything else not to

example.name: Billing api overview
example.description: Traffic, errors and latency of the billing api

Widget.description: A widget of a user analytics dashboard: an analytics query and the way its result is drawn

id.description: The id of the widget, unique within its dashboard. A random one is generated when it is missing or empty

title.description: The title shown in the header of the widget, the id of its query when empty. The backoffice fills it with the name of the query when the widget is created

query.description: The id of an analytics query of the catalog (`GET /api/analytics/_schema` lists them), like `requests_total`, `error_rate_ts` or `duration_avg_ts`

params.description: The parameters of the query, as listed in the catalog of the queries (for instance `top_n`)

type.description: How the result is drawn. It must suit the shape of the result of the query: `line` or `area` for a timeseries, `bar`, `pie`, `donut` or `table` for a top, `scalar` or `metric` for a single value, `heatmap` for a heatmap. Defaults to `line`

width.description: The width of the widget, in columns of the grid. Defaults to 4

height.description: The height of the widget, in rows of the grid. Defaults to 2

options.description: The display options of the widget, read by the backoffice: `format` (`count`, `number`, `compact`, `currency`, `rps`, `ms`, `percent`, `bytes`), `decimals`, `unit`, `currency`, `legend`, `stacked`, `thresholds`, `title`
